items.title: Tinubu Urges APC Leaders To Unite Ahead Of 2027 Elections
items.summary: President Bola Tinubu has urged leaders of the All Progressives Congress to set aside internal grievances and pursue reconciliation ahead of the 2027 elections. Speaking at a prayer event in Lagos, he specifically directed key aides and former ministers to resolve ongoing political rifts in states like Katsina and Jigawa. The president stressed that party cohesion is crucial to consolidating his administration’s governance agenda.
items.why: Marks an early push by the presidency to quell internal party friction and secure political stability ahead of the 2027 electoral cycle.

items.title: I oppose politicians’ children working around govt offices – Makinde
items.summary: Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has expressed strong opposition to children of political leaders working within government offices or leveraging their parents' positions. Speaking in an interview, Makinde noted that his own children lead private lives and pursue independent career paths away from public office. He added that while he would not encourage them to enter politics, he would respect their independent choice if they chose to do so.
items.why: The remarks directly address ongoing public criticism regarding nepotism and political dynasties ahead of Nigeria's 2027 general elections.

items.title: Troops rescue 18 abducted Boys, Girls Brigade children in Kaduna
items.summary: Troops of Operation Fansan Yamma have rescued 18 out of 22 Boys and Girls Brigade members abducted by terrorists in Kaduna State. The children were recovered along the Rehina riverline after soldiers quickly responded to a distress call and pursued the fleeing kidnappers. Military search and rescue operations remain underway to locate the remaining four abducted children.
items.why: Demonstrates rapid military responsiveness while highlighting the persistent security threats facing vulnerable communities in Kaduna State.

items.title: One dies in three-truck crash on Lagos-Ibadan Expressway
items.summary: One person died in a multi-vehicle crash involving three trucks on the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway on Sunday morning. The collision, which occurred near the Ashabi Police Station along the inbound Lagos corridor, was largely blamed on excessive speed by eyewitnesses. Officials of the Ogun State Traffic Compliance and Enforcement Agency quickly cleared the wreckage to restore vehicular movement and prevent secondary accidents.
items.why: It highlights the persistent safety hazards and loss of lives linked to speeding heavy-duty trucks on Nigeria's busiest interstate highway.

items.title: Chelsea Star Robbed After 4-1 Defeat To Leeds United
items.summary: Chelsea forward Emmanuel Emegha was robbed shortly after scoring on his full Premier League debut in a 4-1 home defeat against Leeds United. The 23-year-old took to social media to confirm the incident, assuring supporters that he was unharmed despite the frightening ordeal. Details of the robbery remain scarce, and police authorities have yet to release an official report on the matter.
items.why: The incident adds to mounting concerns over the personal security and targeting of high-profile footballers off the pitch.

items.title: Kipit Asset Management Appoints Mr. Luke Ofojebe, CFA, as Acting Managing Director
items.summary: Kipit Asset Management Limited has appointed Mr. Luke Ofojebe, CFA, as its Acting Managing Director, subject to confirmation by the Securities and Exchange Commission. Ofojebe brings nearly a decade of investment research and portfolio management experience, having previously served as the Chief Investment Officer at Zedcrest Group. In his new role, he is tasked with expanding the firm's market reach, engaging regulators, and driving its research-led investment strategy.
items.why: The leadership change signals Kipit's strategic push to scale its assets under management and build a research-driven portfolio management institution in Nigeria's capital market.

items.title: Moniepoint MFB opens Northern regional headquarters in physical banking push
items.summary: Moniepoint Microfinance Bank has opened its North Central regional headquarters in Abuja to expand its physical footprint in Northern Nigeria. The move complies with Central Bank of Nigeria directives requiring digital lenders to provide accessible, in-person support for customers. The bank aims to use these regional hubs to foster consumer trust without adopting the costly branch-heavy structures of traditional lenders.
items.why: Illustrates how regulatory mandates are driving fintechs toward hybrid banking models to bridge digital adoption and consumer trust.

items.title: Kaduna-Based App Targets Global Market For Nigerian Tailors
items.summary: A new Kaduna-based tech platform, Itta, has launched to connect Nigerian tailors with domestic and international customers. The app features AI-powered sizing technology to eliminate measurement errors and offers digital storefronts to help artisans scale their operations. It seeks to bridge the gap between local fashion entrepreneurs and diaspora clients across Europe and North America.
items.why: Showcases how local tech innovations can formalise informal artisan trades and expand global market access for Nigerian creatives.

items.title: S’African golfer, Kenyan chef arrested with 50kg cannabis in Lagos
items.summary: The National Drug Law Enforcement Agency has intercepted a South African professional golfer and a Kenyan chef at Lagos airport with over 50 kilograms of illicit cannabis. Operatives uncovered a tag-swapping scheme and digital tracking devices designed to conceal ownership and monitor the consignment. The arrests expose an active cross-border trafficking syndicate operating between South Africa and Nigeria.
items.why: Reflects the evolving sophistication of transnational narcotics networks targeting Nigeria and the heightened vigilance of border enforcement agencies.

items.title: Police probe officers over viral pregnant woman video in Abia
items.summary: The Abia State Police Command has launched an investigation into personnel seen in a viral video intercepting a motorist conveying his pregnant wife to a hospital. The officers, attached to the Ubakala Divisional Police Station, had detained the driver for operating a vehicle without number plates despite claims his wife was in active labour. While the police noted the importance of enforcing vehicle identification rules, they stressed that officers must apply discretion when human lives are at risk.
items.why: It spotlights lingering issues of police conduct and the need for humanitarian discretion during routine traffic enforcement in Nigeria.
